## Purpose

Create the sheet every later lesson works on, so there is something to count into.

## Learning objectives

- Create `stockroom.csv` with the four columns of the design.
- Say why the shelf label is the first column.

## Theory

A count that does not say where it was taken cannot be repeated. The shelf label
is therefore part of the count, not decoration around it.

## Completion conditions

`stockroom.csv` exists with a header row naming the four columns.
